answer: Beacon spot-checks and a heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks 1 in 20 agents to answer a proof-of-work heartbeat in 10 minutes, like a river flowing only when each drop proves live. An orchard cannot be planted overnight: each identity serves 5 honest epochs before voting. 100 fakes cost 100 x 5 x 0.5 = 250 POA against a 30 POA reward, a losing tide for attackers. An honest agent pays one heartbeat per epoch and keeps its reward.
